headline: Tango Flight aviation program funding of $14,873 and the 2026-2027 assessment calendar.
summary: A request for $14,873 from the Teaching and Learning Trust would fund the Tango Flight aviation program at the Manchester School of Technology. Also up for approval is the 2026-2027 assessment calendar, and reports cover summer programs, end-of-year data, and professional development.
items: Tango Flight curriculum funds, $14,873 from the Teaching and Learning Trust (for approval)
Professional development overview for 2026-2027 school year (information only)
Teaching and learning highlights and updates: 306 policy, artificial intelligence, federal funds, dual language

Committee Members Parr, Turner, Stewart, Georges, & Smith Aldermanic Chambers 
Student Representatives Achok Lual & Anthony Gammella (MHS) City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
 
1. Chair Parr calls the meeting to order. 
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll. 
 
3. Public Forum  
 
4. Chair Parr advises that the purpose of the public forum is to give the residents of Manchester the 
opportunity to address the board on items of concerns affecting the community; each person will 
be given only one opportunity to speak; comments shall be limited to three minutes to allow all 
participants the opportunity to speak and any comments must be directed to the Chair. Speakers 
may offer comments on school operations and programs that concern them. 
 
5. Chair Parr advises that if there was no one else present wishing to speak, a motion would be in 
order to take all comments under advisement and further to receive and file any written 
documentation presented.
